description: Standing Hearing Committee (SHC) or Standing Appellate Committee (SAC) convenes to hear applicant institutional representatives, review original primary records, and issue statutory recommendations.

entryPrerequisites.description: Formal summons issued with itemized discrepancy statement or valid SAC appeal memorandum filed within 7 days.

allowedTransitions.aphRuleCitation: RULE-SHC-002 / Chap II Cl. 2.21 & RULE-SAC-002 / Cl. 2.24(b)
validationRules: Hearing minutes must be signed by committee Chairman (retired High Court Judge / Senior Academician)
Hearing video recording transcript reference must be recorded
Clear recommendation (Approval, Rejection, or Reduced Intake) explicitly noted
Allowed only where disputed physical facts cannot be resolved by documents alone
Formal order memo detailing specific parameters to verify physically must be attached

timePolicy.description: Hearing Disposal SLA: Committee hearing and minutes compilation within 10 working days of docketing.

exitConditions.description: Signed recommendations submitted to the Council / Competent Authority dossier.
